faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Bhopal Project Technical Support – II Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application form for AIIMS Bhopal Project Technical Support – II Recruitment 2026 is 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Project Technical Support – II posts?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Project Technical Support – II post in AIIMS Bhopal Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for AIIMS Bhopal Project Technical Support – II?
faq.answer: The application mode for AIIMS Bhopal Project Technical Support – II Recruitment 2026 is Online. Candidates need to submit their applications through the official website.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for Project Technical Support – II post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Technical Support – II post is 30 years as of the specified cut-off date. Please refer to the official notification for exact details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Project Technical Support – II at AIIMS Bhopal?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for Project Technical Support – II will receive a salary of ₹20,000/- per month along with HRA 20%.

faq.question: Q6. What are the essential qualifications for Project Technical Support – II?
faq.answer: Candidates need 12th in Science with a relevant diploma and experience, or a Three Year Graduation/B.Sc. (Hons) in a related field with experience. Specific details are in the eligibility section.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Bhopal Project Technical Support – II Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the AIIMS Bhopal Project Technical Support – II Recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Project Technical Support – II?
faq.answer: The selection process for Project Technical Support – II includes shortlisting of candidates followed by an Interview or Written Test.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the Project Technical Support – II post be located?
faq.answer: The job location for the Project Technical Support – II post will be in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, at AIIMS Bhopal.

faq.question: Q10. When is the tentative interview date for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The tentative interview date for the AIIMS Bhopal Project Technical Support – II recruitment is scheduled for the 2nd Week of September 2026.
